data.one_liner: A simple animation listview widget that shows list items by sliding and bouncing.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AnimationList widget that displays children with sliding, bouncing, and opacity animations when built. It wraps standard ListView capabilities and supports vertical, horizontal, or both animation directions.
use_when: You want a list view where items animate into view with a sliding and bouncing effect.
You need configurable animation duration, bounce depth, and opacity ranges for list items.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based motion or advanced choreography like Rive or Lottie.
You require fine-grained item-removal animations beyond standard list scrolling behavior.
strengths: Easy to use with a familiar API similar to standard list views.
Supports multiple animation directions including vertical, horizontal, and both.
weaknesses: Limited to specific sliding and bouncing entrance animations.
No documentation on fine-grained individual item insert/remove animations.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive and flexible animation system for any widget including lists, rather than being restricted to a single list view widget.

alternatives.name: animate_do
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers ready-to-use entrance animations for individual widgets if you want to compose custom animated lists manually.
